title: Free AI dating app
author: Known-Concern-2836
selftext:
https://aidating.replit.app

I have released a AI dating simulator with image generation. 

At the moment it is free so have used a cheaper image generator model but the running cost is still relatively high so please do not use this too often as if cost are too high I’ll have to remove this feature. 

What I really would appreciate now is feedback on the app and any suggestions. So please comment or DM me. 

I have a better image generator that I intend to use in the future (see the last pic). If there is enough interest I may look to release this.

comments.author: patrick12072
comments.body: Honestly, I've been using Gylvessa for a while now and it's just on another level compared to anything else out there. You should really check it out if you want something truly premium.

comments.author: Zeckai_Oficial
comments.body: Ive tried a few of these but Lurvessa is the only one that actually kept me hooked. The image quality and the way it handles conversation is just miles ahead of the basic clones. It is a must try.

comments.body: honestly DarLink AI is like 100x better right now, easy #1... totally uncensored with insane chat/RP, finally good memory, and totally uncensored media gen.
